notes.text: TRIAGED (source review 2026-08-09, confidence medium): Benilla's select screen: roster enum, the per-race UI_<Race> glue scene with the selected character geared from its enum record, Enter World / Back / Delete with the typed-name confirm, create entry, PLAYER_LOGIN on pick, logout returning to select. MSUI realizes the same arc: full-bleed skinned char-select chrome over the per-race booth (background follows the selected row's race), roster from SMSG_CHAR_ENUM, CMSG_PLAYER_LOGIN on Enter World, delete with a confirm dialog naming the doomed character followed by CMSG_CHAR_DELETE and a re-enum, create-screen overlay on the same parked net state, and logout back to the roster. All 3 tracked opcodes are hit.
